content:
Jarvis前端磁贴风改造阶段3完成：13个组件文件+diff.css的border/backdrop-filter/box-shadow/border-radius/border-color同步修改已完成。

已处理文件：
1. SettingsModal.vue - border→none, backdrop-filter删除, box-shadow→tile-shadow, border-radius变量化, border-color→subtle
2. CreateAgentModal.vue - 同上，toggle开关组件改造
3. AgentSidebar.vue - border→none, border-right/bottom→subtle, box-shadow→tile-shadow, border-radius变量化
4. TerminalPanel.vue - border→none, border-bottom→subtle, box-shadow→tile-shadow, border-radius变量化
5. EditorPanel.vue - border→none, box-shadow→tile-shadow, backdrop-filter删除, border-bottom/right→subtle
6. DirectoryDialog.vue - border→none, border-radius变量化
7. SessionDialog.vue - border→none, border-bottom→subtle, border-radius变量化
8. BufferPanel.vue - border→none, box-shadow→tile-shadow, border-top/bottom→subtle
9. CompletionsModal.vue - border→none, border-bottom→subtle, border-radius变量化
10. ConnectModal.vue - border→none, box-shadow→tile-shadow, border-radius变量化
11. RenameAgentModal.vue - border→none, border-radius变量化
12. ConfirmDialog.vue - border→none, border-color→subtle, border-radius变量化
13. diff.css - border-radius变量化, rgba border→subtle

待完成：阶段4构建验证(npm run build)
